verdict.rationale: Pomelo's developer docs say it can create cards, including virtual ones, so the core issuing capability exists. Nothing shows a one-call API creation that returns PAN, CVV and expiry right away. The integration guide also describes a formal project kickoff before the first live virtual-card transaction, which points to an onboarding process rather than self-serve sandbox-to-live. Missing for 10: evidence of a single-call virtual card creation endpoint, programmatic retrieval of PAN/CVV/expiry at issuance, a self-serve sandbox-to-production path without a sales or kickoff cycle, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a virtual card through the API in one call — PAN, CVV, and expiry available programmatically the moment it's issued — and go from sandbox to a live card without a sales cycle
